title: Devil-Chi
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ordinary high-school student Fuyuki Hino vaguely remembers a childhood promise to his painfully shy classmate Yomi. When he blunders into the girls' locker room he discovers she is a devil, wings and all. The webcomic romcom follows Yomi's ordinary school problems, including bullies and wanting to be liked, alongside supernatural rivals such as angels.
life_message: Accepting someone's hidden, different self and keeping a promise made in childhood are signs of real affection.
